name: Claude collaboration workspace
description: Let Antigravity and Claude share a folder: one memory, and each can read the other's chats, send it messages and start sessions. Right-click (long-press on a phone) a folder in the Antigravity sidebar and choose "Make this a shared workspace with Claude"; from then on Antigravity reads and updates Claude's memory there by itself, and both sidebars show the folder as shared. Host only.

collab-on.label: Make this a shared workspace with Claude
